# Tax Structure Documentation

## Complete Tax Object Fields

```javascript
{
  // Auto-generated by IndexedDB
  id: "unique-id-string",
  
  // Tax classification
  type: "percentage" | "fixed",
  
  // Tax amount/rate
  value: 15,  // numeric value (15% or 1000 units)
  
  // When tax applies (optional)
  payPer: "hour" | "month" | "year" | null,
  
  // Currency for fixed taxes only
  currency: "RUB" | "USD" | "AMD",  // ONLY for type: "fixed"
  
  // Multilingual labels
  label: {
    en: "Income Tax",
    hy: "Եկամտային հարկ",
    ru: "Налог на доход"
  },
  
  // Multilingual descriptions
  description: {
    en: "Tax on income",
    hy: "Եկամտի վրա հարկ",
    ru: "Налог на заработок"
  },
  
  // Work type
  workType: "individual" | "registered"
}
```

## Percentage Tax Examples

### Example 1: Income Tax (15%)
```javascript
{
  id: "tax-001",
  type: "percentage",
  value: 15,
  payPer: null,  // applies to all periods
  label: {
    en: "Income Tax",
    hy: "Եկամտային հարկ",
    ru: "Налог на доход"
  },
  description: {
    en: "15% tax on income",
    hy: "15% հարկ եկամտից",
    ru: "15% налог на доход"
  },
  workType: "individual"
}
```

**Display:** `Income Tax (15%)`
**Calculation:** gross_salary × 0.15

---

### Example 2: Social Insurance (8.5%)
```javascript
{
  id: "tax-002",
  type: "percentage",
  value: 8.5,
  payPer: "month",
  label: {
    en: "Social Insurance",
    hy: "Հանցուկ ապահովում",
    ru: "Социальное страхование"
  },
  description: {
    en: "Monthly social insurance contribution",
    hy: "Ամսական հանցուկ ապահովման վճար",
    ru: "Ежемесячный взнос социального страхования"
  },
  workType: "individual"
}
```

**Display:** `Social Insurance (8.5%)`
**Calculation:** gross_salary × 0.085

## Fixed Amount Tax Examples

### Example 1: Fixed Tax in RUB
```javascript
{
  id: "tax-003",
  type: "fixed",
  value: 500,
  payPer: "month",
  currency: "RUB",  // REQUIRED for fixed type
  label: {
    en: "Monthly Fee",
    hy: "Ամսական վճար",
    ru: "Ежемесячная плата"
  },
  description: {
    en: "Fixed monthly registration fee",
    hy: "Ամսական գրանցման վճար",
    ru: "Фиксированная ежемесячная регистрационная плата"
  },
  workType: "individual"
}
```

**Display:** `Monthly Fee (500 ₽)`
**Calculation:** gross_salary - 500 RUB (converted to display currency)

---

### Example 2: Fixed Tax in USD
```javascript
{
  id: "tax-004",
  type: "fixed",
  value: 100,
  payPer: "year",
  currency: "USD",
  label: {
    en: "Annual License",
    hy: "Տարեկան լիցենզ",
    ru: "Годовая лицензия"
  },
  description: {
    en: "Annual business license fee",
    hy: "Տարեկան բիզնես լիցենզի գումար",
    ru: "Годовой сбор за деловую лицензию"
  },
  workType: "individual"
}
```

**Display:** `Annual License (100 $)`
**Calculation:** gross_salary - 100 USD (converted to display currency)

---

### Example 3: Fixed Tax in AMD
```javascript
{
  id: "tax-005",
  type: "fixed",
  value: 10000,
  payPer: "month",
  currency: "AMD",
  label: {
    en: "Pension Fund",
    hy: "Պենսիա ֆոնդ",

  },
  description: {
    en: "Monthly pension fund contribution",
    hy: "Ամսական պենսիոն ֆոնդի ներդրում",
```

## Field Validation Rules

| Field | Type | Required | Possible Values | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-----------------|-------|
| `id` | string | Auto | Any string | Generated by IndexedDB |
| `type` | string | ✅ Yes | "percentage", "fixed" | Must be one of these |
| `value` | number | ✅ Yes | 0-100 for %, any positive for fixed | Cannot be undefined |
| `payPer` | string | ❌ No | "hour", "month", "year", null | Optional, can be null |
| `currency` | string | ✅ if type="fixed" | "RUB", "USD", "AMD" | Required ONLY for fixed taxes |
| `label` | object | ✅ Yes | {en: "...", hy: "...", ru: "..."} | At least one language required |
| `description` | object | ❌ No | {en: "...", hy: "...", ru: "..."} | Optional |
| `workType` | string | ✅ Yes | "individual", "registered" | Set automatically by app |

---

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

❌ **WRONG - Percentage tax with currency**
```javascript
{
  type: "percentage",
  value: 15,
  currency: "RUB"  // ❌ Don't add currency for percentage!
}
```

✅ **CORRECT - Percentage tax without currency**
```javascript
{
  type: "percentage",
  value: 15,
  // No currency field
}
```

---

❌ **WRONG - Fixed tax without currency**
```javascript
{
  type: "fixed",
  value: 500
  // ❌ Missing currency!
}
```

✅ **CORRECT - Fixed tax with currency**
```javascript
{
  type: "fixed",
  value: 500,
  currency: "RUB"  // ✅ Always include for fixed
}
```

---

❌ **WRONG - Using 'amount' field**
```javascript
{
  amount: 15  // ❌ Wrong field name!
}
```

✅ **CORRECT - Using 'value' field**
```javascript
{
  value: 15  // ✅ Correct field name
}
```

## Database Storage

Taxes are stored in IndexedDB with store names:
- `individual_taxes` - Taxes for Individual Entrepreneur type
- `registered_taxes` - Taxes for Registered Worker type

Each tax object is stored as a complete record with all fields preserved.
